guidelineReference: SJA First Aid / minor wound care
title: Cut finger at a craft festival
setting: Craft festival. An adult cut a finger on a craft knife. Small wound bleeding slightly. In some pain but moving the finger and talking normally.
verdictExplanation: Alert, stable observations, a minor superficial wound with slight bleeding and preserved function. Not sick: simple wound care and safety-netting on scene.

shared.danger: A craft knife is somewhere nearby
shared.breathing: Fast at first, settles when talking

history.history: Cut moments ago, reports severe pain

followUp.question: What is your management?

options.text: Clean the wound, apply a dressing with direct pressure, check movement and circulation
Apply a tourniquet to the finger
Leave it open and uncovered to air-dry

followUp.explanation: Minor wounds are cleaned, dressed and managed with brief direct pressure, then check the finger still moves and is well perfused. This is not a 999 situation, and a tourniquet is reserved for life-threatening limb haemorrhage.

levelExplanation.er: Advise on tetanus status and safety-net for signs of infection before discharge.

levelFlags.erNotes: Reassure: high reported pain with a minor wound is common. Treat the wound, not the pain score in isolation.
